name: Rogério Ceni
scopeNote: Narrowed to Fortaleza 2018-19 (spell 2017-11-10 to 2019-08-11, 4-2-4 / four mobile forwards, possession-based and offensive, called 'esquema 4-2-4' by Diario do Nordeste) and Flamengo 2020/21 (spell 2020-11-10 to 2021-07-10; Domenec Torrent was sacked 2020-11-09, so only Ceni's part is counted). The Flamengo style is described by local press as a 3-4-2-1/3-4-3 build-up with a back four without the ball, borrowing Jorge Jesus 2019 concepts (high pressure on the opponent's build-up); it is not 'Guardiola positional play', although Correio Braziliense says he tried to apply Guardiola concepts at Sao Paulo and Fortaleza (2020, outside counted spell). Brazilian sources are thin: almost no tier A, no source states zonal or man-marking, and the Flamengo spell has no dedicated tactical study (Total Football Analysis covers only his 2022 Sao Paulo). Partial dates: excluded Sao Paulo start 2017-01 and excluded Fortaleza second spell start 2020-01 are approximate (day not found). Spell start at Fortaleza is the signing date; the exact first day in charge was not found.
openQuestions: Fortaleza start: signing 2017-11-10 versus first day in charge (presentation the following Wednesday, first match Jan 2018). Confirm.
No source found on zonal vs man-marking for either spell; only 'marcacao encaixada' (Fortaleza 2020, Diario do Nordeste, excluded) and 'marca a frente'.

Several summaries said Flamengo won the 2020 Brasileirao under Ceni; O POVO counts it among his three trophies (Serie A 2020, Supercopa 2021, Carioca 2021) although he took over mid-season. Check how much of that title is credited to Torrent vs Ceni (Flamengo were 3rd, 1 point behind, when he arrived).
Ceni's game count at Flamengo: O POVO says 44 games (23W 11D 10L), CNN Brasil says 45 (23W 11D 11L).
Fortaleza second spell (2020) start date not verified; it is excluded from the counted spells but would give better tactical coverage (Diario do Nordeste, Correio Braziliense).
Alleged friction with the board over signing Fortaleza players (leaked audio, 2021-07) is unconfirmed.
